sv.title: Samma land, samma el – olika villkor
sv.summary: När elpriserna skiljer kraftigt mellan landets elområden tvingas företagen konkurrera med helt olika energikostnader. Det snedvrider konkurrensen och avgör framtidens investeringar, skriver näringslivet i Gislaved.

en.title: Same country, same electricity – different conditions
en.summary: When electricity prices differ sharply between the country's bidding zones, companies are forced to compete with entirely different energy costs. This distorts competition and determines future investments, writes the business community in Gislaved.
